newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Zimbabwe's short-term money rates were quoted mixed in quiet trade on Thursday, local dealers said.
They said the central Reserve Bank auctioned Z$70 million worth of 30-day treasury bills at an average yield of 23.10 percent from 23.08 percent at Wednesday's auction for 51-day paper.

NCD bills with maturity of 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 24 percent and sold at 23 percent, unchanged from Wednesday's levels. Call money, which was indicated at 20 percent the previous day, fluctuated between 19 and 20 percent.
Bank acceptances bills were quoted at 23.75 percent (buying) from 23.5 percent and sold in a 22.9 to 23.25 percentage range from 22.75 percent.
Central bank figures indicated a Z$9 million market surplus at the close of Wednesday trade.
